title: Ron Evans and BAE's Project Greenglow anti-gravity research
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Ron Evans and BAE's Project Greenglow anti-gravity research, about about ten years (dates not given) at BAE Systems, United Kingdom, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Um, there's a guy named Dr. Ron Evans there who talked about something called Project Greenlow and he actually wrote a book about this public.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that a scientist named Dr. Ron Evans, at the British defence company BAE Systems, spoke about something called Project Greenglow, a research effort into anti-gravity. Michels adds that Evans wrote a public book about it, which would mean a major arms maker openly looked into ways of beating gravity.
